SPICY REVEAL DROP 05 — FILMSTRIP 5× (Gemini 9:16)

OUTPUT: ONE tall image. FIVE complete SPICY REVEAL promo banners stacked top to bottom (Telegram scroll filmstrip). Each panel: wide landscape banner (~16:9) with full UI chrome. Overall composite: 9:16 portrait strip. NOT 2×2 grid.

Panel order: PANEL-1 TRIAL PHOTO, PANEL-2 SHE REMEMBERS, PANEL-3 EARN REVEAL, PANEL-4 THE PIPELINE, PANEL-5 FULL PACK GATE.

LAYOUT LOCK per panel: distressed white AOF + coral SPICY REVEAL, panel subtitle, compact QR, coral pill columns, telegram.me/aof_spicybot_bot link bar, footer icons. Same UI every panel, vary backgrounds only.

STYLE: phone DM noir, magenta-coral accents, flirt companion energy, SFW, no explicit nudity, readable mobile text.

AVOID: 2x2 grid, bleeding panels, misspelled text, BUY language on poster.
